comment: The DSP is Émilie Gillet's Plaits at firmware 1.2, vendored unchanged at eurorack/plaits; src/Funes.cpp is the Rack wrapper, running one Plaits voice per polyphonic channel. The trigger threshold is not the 0.7V the wrapper's own comment at Funes.cpp:249 gives: Funes.cpp:250 divides the jack voltage by 3 and voice.cc:99 compares the result against 0.3, so the input goes high at 0.9V, and voice.cc:108 releases it below 0.3V. The two low-pass gate jacks are read with getVoltage() at Funes.cpp:213 and Funes.cpp:215, outside the per-channel loop, so they are monophonic and apply to every voice; the maker marks this with silver jacks and says so in the manual. The model offset is sampled and held at each trigger: voice.cc:105 copies it on the rising edge, and voice.cc:113 reads it continuously only when nothing is patched to the trigger. The LEVEL input is compressed and constrained to 0..1 at voice.cc:152, and with nothing patched the accent is fixed at 0.8 and the trigger strikes the low-pass gate instead. The menu item the manual calls Open custom data editors in web browser... is spelled Open editors in web browser... in the source.
